image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a wet, textured rocky surface. The chiton has an oval shape with eight distinct, overlapping dorsal plates visible in a linear series. It is surrounded by a rough, granular girdle. Small snails and barnacles are visible on the surrounding rock.
